title: RLInsight
description: Automated Rocket League match analysis bot that polls the Ballchasing API for new replays, uses GPT to compare player stats against historical win/loss patterns, and delivers AI coaching feedback directly to Discord.

title: NDIA Hackathon Dashboard
description: Interactive Streamlit dashboard built for an NDIA hackathon that visualizes pilot training performance trends, displaying average grades across event categories and syllabi as an interactive heatmap.

title: Fake News Classifier
description: Deep learning project that fine-tunes a BERT model combined with LSTM layers to classify news articles as real or fake, achieving 96% accuracy through contextual embeddings and text preprocessing.

title: Movie Review Data Analysis
description: Exploratory data analysis and machine learning project that investigates factors driving movie success, using sentiment analysis on reviews and a Random Forest classifier to predict whether a film will be a hit or a flop.

title: Huge VQA Dataset Tool
description: Tool for generating large-scale visual question-answering datasets by leveraging GPT-4V to automatically produce question-answer pairs from images, eliminating the need for crowdsourcing.
